verdict.rationale: Lever publishes public developer documentation at hire.lever.co/developer/documentation. It covers REST-style endpoints such as creating and listing applications, listing deleted applications and listing audit events, plus OAuth authentication, so the product itself can be driven programmatically. The evidence is mostly section headings, so the depth and breadth of the API are only implied. Missing for 10: detailed endpoint coverage across core objects (candidates, postings, interviews), rate-limit and versioning documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
